Name: SVE Portraits - Sandy and Jace
Author: daggerrk
Description:
It is truly very easy to get this to work.

[list=1]
[*]Just [b]download [/b]the zip file
[*][b]Extract [/b]it
[*][b]Copy/Cut [/b]the portrait folders (named after the characters) inside it (I hope you don't expect me to teach you how to do this)
[*][b]Paste [/b]the folders inside Mods/Stardew Valley Expanded/[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded/assets/CharacterFiles/Portraits/
[*][b]Replace [/b]the original folders with the new ones
[/list]
And done, that's it! If you want to suggest more portraits to add in the future, please feel free to do so :D
